title: Write a workbook
summary: Write a fixed table of text and number cells, one to three sheets, to an XLSX workbook held in memory, and return the file's bytes.
notes: One operation builds a workbook of 1 to 3 sheets of 6 to 251 rows by 3 to 8 columns (text and numbers) and serializes it to XLSX bytes in memory. The bytes differ between libraries (shared or inline strings, compression, styles); the verifier unzips each file and compares sheet names and every cell's type and value.
